Retry rules, all settings
updates: 3 tries within about a minute, so a lane never stays stuck
outbox: 5 tries, waiting as long as Telegram asks
work: 5 tries, backoff 30 seconds to 30 minutes
what can never succeed: straight to its dead-letter queue

dead-letter queues
updates · outbox · work · scheduler
kept 14 days

Replay moves messages back to their queue
phase 1: scripts/redrive.sh · phase 5: [Replay] on the alert
phase 12: the ops warden, once the cause is healthy,
at most 3 times, then an incident
an update over an hour old asks "still want this?"
